_readme: Sub parameters for fly_auv.py. EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER until you replace it with your sub's real values (CAD mass properties, thruster layout).
Body frame: origin = centre of gravity, +x = nose (forward), +y = left, +z = up. All positions are in metres from the centre of gravity.
thrusters: pos_m = where the thruster sits, dir = the direction it pushes the sub when given positive thrust (does not need to be unit length).
The default layout is 4 horizontal thrusters angled 45 degrees at the corners (surge/sway/yaw) + 4 vertical thrusters (heave/pitch/roll).
fly_auv.py works out the thruster mixing automatically from this table, so a different layout only needs different rows here.
mesh.file: path to your sub STL (null = draw a plain ellipsoid). The mesh is converted like the course props. Its nose must point +x and its top +z after the fixes;
use rotate_deg [rx, ry, rz] (degrees, about x, y, z in that order) and offset_m to line it up. offset_m shifts the mesh so the centre of gravity ends up at the body origin.
